fieldValues.title: A pull request with a red E2E check merged, and main stayed red for every later pull request
fieldValues.summary: srs-web#711 merged on 2026-11-04 with E2E shard 1/3 failing, and main has no branch protection, so nothing stopped it. Its two new tests failed only in CI, which serves the built bundle over http, while a local run uses the dev server. Every later srs-web pull request then showed the same red check, which reads as that pull request's own failure until someone compares it with main.
evidence: 2026-11-04. srs-web#711 status checks: E2E (Playwright) 1/3 FAILURE, E2E (Playwright) FAILURE, merged 14:25 UTC. main CI at 7497922: failure. srs-web#713 CI: the same two tests, essay-home.spec.ts:22 and :27. GET branches/main/protection: 404 Branch not protected. Reproduced locally with CI=1. Fixed by srs-web#715 (issue #714).
fieldValues.body: The cause of the test failure is a bug: parseOpenUrl refused the app's own origin over http. Production is always https and was not affected. The stop is that a failing required-in-practice check did not stop the merge, and that the local gate cannot see the failure unless it is run with CI=1. Options to weigh: protect main so E2E is required; have the local gate run the built bundle. Neither is chosen here.
